title: Kernel treated constants as `Nat` literals when reducing `Nat.pow`
summary: A missing check in the kernel's `Nat.pow` reduction falsely interpreted an expression as a `Nat` literal. With GMP enabled (the default), this is a soundness bug: one can prove False. With GMP disabled, the kernel instead crashes on some inputs. Would be caught by lean4lean and nanoda. Affects stable versions 4.14.0 through 4.19.0 inclusive.
